note: `<inline-raw-scalar>` (§ 4) terminates on the first unescaped `,`/`}`/`]` regardless of which container it belongs to; raw mode makes openers literal but does not suspend this termination grammar. The unescaped `]` ends the raw scalar before the Object's own `}`, leaving the Object unclosed. Escaped form `{a:: x\]}` stays valid.
